Description: As a student, I want to enroll in available courses so that I can access learning content.
Acceptance Criteria: Epic created for Course Enrollment feature validation.

Description: As a student, I want to successfully enroll in a course so that I can begin learning.
Acceptance Criteria: Student can enroll in an available course; enrollment confirmation is displayed; duplicate enrollment is handled; invalid requests show appropriate validation messages.

Description: Generate BDD-format test cases for the Course Enrollment feature using Microsoft Copilot.
Acceptance Criteria: Five BDD test cases are created using Given/When/Then format and reviewed.

Description: Create synthetic CSV test data containing valid and invalid enrollment scenarios.
Acceptance Criteria: Dataset contains 10 records with required fields such as UserID, FirstName, CourseID, DateOfBirth, and ExpectedResult.

Description: Import and execute Course Enrollment test cases in Zephyr.
Acceptance Criteria: All test cases are linked to the Course Enrollment story and executed with Pass/Fail status recorded in the test cycle.

Summary: Course Enrollment Failure for Specific Data
Description: Enrollment fails with an application error when a supported-looking input value is submitted.
Acceptance Criteria: Defect contains reproduction steps, expected result, actual result, and supporting DevTools evidence.

Description: Investigate the enrollment failure using browser DevTools and complete the 5-Whys RCA document.
Acceptance Criteria: RCA includes a logical five-level analysis, identified root cause, corrective action, and DevTools evidence.

Description: Populate the Excel dashboard with execution metrics including Pass Rate and Defect Density.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard displays calculated metrics and an updated Pass versus Fail chart.
